title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 275 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 275 - Penalty for Default in Payment of Tax Where a taxpayer defaults in payment of tax or is deemed to be in default, the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes may direct that such sum can be collected, in addition to the tax due, shall not exceed the said tax due as penalty. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail.
